PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Stores a player's profile identity and career Ludo statistics.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the player.

displayName.description: Display name shown in Ludo lobbies and turn banners.

gamesPlayed.description: Total number of Ludo matches played.

gamesWon.description: Total number of Ludo matches won.

capturesTotal.description: Total opponent tokens captured across matches.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

LudoRoom.title: LudoRoom
LudoRoom.description: Represents an online multiplayer Ludo game room and its synchronized board state.

hostUid.description: UID of the player who created and hosts the room.

isPublic.description: Whether the room is discoverable in quick public matchmaking.

memberUids.description: List of authenticated Firebase UIDs participating in this room.

playerNames.description: Display names of players seated in the room.

playerColors.description: Assigned Ludo colors (RED, GREEN, YELLOW, BLUE) for seated players.

playerUids.description: UIDs or bot identifiers aligned with playerColors.

tokens.description: 16 integers representing positions of all 16 tokens (-1 in yard, 0..50 track, 51..56 home stretch, 57 finished).

currentTurnColor.description: Color of the player whose turn is currently active.

turnPhase.description: Current phase within the active turn.

diceValue.description: Current rolled die face (1..6, or 0 before first roll).

consecutiveSixes.description: Number of consecutive 6s rolled in the current turn (0..2).

lastEvent.description: Human-readable description of the latest move or rule event.

reactionEmoji.description: Latest quick emoji reaction sent by a player.

reactionSender.description: Display name or color of the player who sent the latest emoji reaction.

winnerColor.description: First-place winner color, or NONE while match is in progress.

winnerOrder.description: Ordered list of player colors that have finished all 4 tokens.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the room was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated player's profile and Ludo career stats.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Stores real-time multiplayer Ludo room state, board tokens, and turn synchronization.
